signature.name: Cold-run reproducibility
signature.description: Could a fresh session given only the skill folder and an unseen repo execute SKILL.md deterministically, with declared dependencies, loud failures, explicit stop conditions and no author-machine paths.

group-a.signature_why: Step 0 preflight (check-env + selftest 77/77, 18/18 seeded lies) gates everything; every step has Output and Stop-if; scripts exit 2/1 with messages; no author paths; demo lint/firstscreen/assets all re-run green.
group-a.loved: Preflight plus decision rule for selftest failures, and a ledger-backed lint that I re-ran against the demo and it passed.
group-a.docked: Heavy 8-step, 4-gate process with a 700-line script set is a lot for an agent to follow; first demo image shows only stat tiles, and the demo is light-only.

group-b.signature_why: Loud exit codes and an honest INCOMPLETE/exit 3 banner (I saw it fire without the env var); but default Playwright path is missing on a clean machine so capture and render paths go untested until a 150 MB install.
group-b.loved: selftest.sh refusing to call tooling passing when browser paths were skipped; verify.mjs re-ran 101/101.
group-b.docked: Demo README ends with a process-leak line about unverified commands, and the Reel quotes raw JSON, which is the weakest proof; hidden Playwright dependency needs an install step.

group-c.signature_why: Stdlib-only Python, clear exit codes and 33/33 tests plus checker re-run PASS, but no end-to-end fixture run and crop coordinates still need hand-picking; cold-run fixes were not re-run cold.
group-c.loved: Smallest dependency surface, checker passes on demo, and LEFT-OUT.md records every guess as a skill defect.
group-c.docked: Only the checker is tested, not capture.sh or inspect_repo; the rendered demo shows raw ** in the code block and a clipped line on the first screen.
